  "pros": [
    "Effective for structuring sales pipeline and managing leads.",
    "Good value for the features provided for a mid-sized company.",
    "Customization options helped tailor it to specific logistics processes."

  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and customization required a significant learning curve.",
    "Reporting features sometimes lacked the depth needed for detailed analysis.",
    "Integrations with other niche logistics tools were occasionally challenging."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Project Analyst found Zoho CRM to be a capable tool for managing the sales pipeline and structuring leads and deals within their logistics company. While appreciating its value and customization potential, they likely experienced some initial friction with the learning curve and wished for more advanced reporting capabilities. Overall, it served its purpose adequately for their 1-2 years of use."
